Welcome to the new Integrated Fisheries Ecology Lab website. Here, you can find our [research projects](../../research/), the [people](../../people/) who make the lab, our [papers](../../papers/), and [information for prospective students](../../prospective-students/).

The site is built with Quarto, so lab members can add news posts and update their own profiles by editing simple text files.
